title: The Short Oxford History of English Literature

vibeProfile.oneLine: A single-volume history of the whole of English literature.

summary: Andrew Sanders's widely used single-volume history surveys the whole span of English literature from Anglo-Saxon times to the late twentieth century. Combining a clear chronological narrative with critical discussion of major writers and works, it packs an enormous amount into one accessible book. A reliable, balanced and readable overview, it has become a standard first history for students and a handy reference for anyone wanting the whole story of English literature in one volume.
whyReadIt: The standard one-volume history of English literature, from Beowulf to the moderns. Clear, balanced and reliable.
